USDA Choice Angus Ribeye (St. Helens): Angus ribeye graded USDA Choice, grain-finished, from the American producer St. Helens. Well marbled, so it eats richer and sweeter than grass-fed beef.
USDA Choice Black Angus Ribeye (Demkota): Black Angus ribeye graded USDA Choice, grain-finished, from the American producer Demkota. Generous marbling through the eye gives it a buttery, full beef flavour.
USDA Choice Black Angus Ribeye(Nebraska): Black Angus ribeye graded USDA Choice, grain-finished and wet-aged for 28 days — the only one of the three American ribeyes that is aged. The ageing leaves it noticeably more tender, with a deeper, faintly tangy beef flavour.
